tool.name: Perseus Setup Taxonomy Database
tool.description: download and build the ETE3 taxonomy database used by Perseus
tool.command: mkdir -p taxonomy_db && #if not $test_data_manager: perseus setup taxonomy_db && #end if python '$__tool_directory__/make_json.py' --output '$out_file' --path taxonomy_db
tool.help:
**What it does**
Downloads the current NCBI taxonomy and builds the ETE3 taxonomy database required by Perseus.
The resulting taxonomy database is installed as shared Galaxy reference data and registered in the ``perseus_taxonomy_db`` tool data table.
The installed database can then be used by the Perseus Extract Features and Filter Kraken2 Output tools.
